empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

editor.title: Configuration
editor.name: Name
editor.descriptionHint: This description is the skill's interface — the agent reads it to decide whether the skill applies. Write it as a direct instruction (e.g. "Use when reviewing test files"), not as freeform notes to yourself.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.empty: This skill has no body yet.

comingSoon.title: Evals are coming soon
comingSoon.body: Eval cases let you pin a diff to an expected finding and re-score the skill on every edit. The scoring engine is not built yet — nothing here is measured today.

comingSoon.title: Stats are coming soon
comingSoon.body: Usage, pull frequency, and accept rate need review telemetry that is not collected yet. Once reviews record which skills reached the prompt, this tab will report it.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.

empty.title: No saved versions yet
empty.body: Editing and saving the skill body snapshots a version here.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

community.title: Search community skills
community.subtitle: Import vetted skills from public repos

comingSoon.title: Community search is coming soon
comingSoon.body: Browsing and importing vetted skills from public repos needs a catalog service that is not wired up yet. Import from a file in the meantime.
